hero.title: Tell me about your celebration.
hero.body: Whether it's your wedding, your best friend's bachelorette, or a birthday worth documenting, I'd love to hear about it. Share a few details below and I'll follow up with my availability and packages.
hero.note: Planning for someone else? Bridesmaids, moms, and best friends are welcome to inquire too.

nextSteps.title: What happens next
steps: I read every detail and check my calendar for your date.
You'll get an email with my availability and packages.
If it feels like a fit, we lock in your date and start planning the fun part.

seo.title: Inquire | Curated by Nat, Wedding & Event Content in GA
seo.description: Tell Nat about your wedding, bachelorette weekend, bridal event, or celebration in Georgia. Share a few details to get her availability and packages.
